config.database.pdb.name: XEPDB1
config.//table: ONE connector, both tables - include-lists are fully matched, so ACCOUNT does not accidentally also match ACCOUNT_BLOB; each must be listed explicitly. A second connector would open a second LogMiner session mining the SAME redo stream twice - redo mining is 65-71% of measured end-to-end latency, so that cost is real, not theoretical.
config.//column: Only the 2 physically stored columns per table - the other 9 on ACCOUNT are virtual and arrive as garbage text without this filter. column.include.list is a whitelist across ALL captured tables - omitting ACCOUNT_BLOB here would silently drop every one of its columns, not just leave it at defaults.
config.//lob: Required - XMLRECORD is XMLTYPE (a hidden BLOB) and BLOBRECORD is a native BLOB. Both reach Debezium via LOB redo entries, consumed identically through this one setting.
config.//strategy: online_catalog avoids waiting on log archival to see changes (default redo_log_catalog can stall indefinitely on XE's small redo logs). Trade-off: can't track DDL on the captured table - fine here.
config.//benchmarks: On a connector's first-ever run, take a full snapshot of the current table contents before switching to streaming new changes.
